blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Widely used category discovery benchmarks have become increasingly saturated and often fail to reflect real-world discovery settings, making long-term evaluation of new methods difficult. We introduce PS-SPLIT, a large-scale fine-grained benchmark for category discovery, motivated by taxonomic splitting: the real-world process by which what was once considered a single species is found to comprise multiple distinct ones. PS-SPLIT contains 79K globally distributed, high-quality, community-collected bird images spanning 771 species, derived from 257 recent real expert-verified taxonomic splits, with associated geographic metadata and full taxonomic hierarchy. The visual differences between categories arising from real taxonomic splits can be very subtle, often requiring significant human expertise to tell apart, making PS-SPLIT a challenging benchmark which we hope will assist in advancing fine-grained category discovery research. Based on taxonomic splitting, we introduce the task of discovery by category splitting, where the goal is to determine which known categories should be subdivided into new finer-grained subcategories. We adapt four generalized category discovery methods to this setting, evaluate existing methods, and show that there is substantial room for future progress.
blocks.zh: 广泛使用的类别发现基准越来越饱和,往往不能反映现实世界的发现环境,因此难以对新方法进行长期评价。 我们引入了PS-SPLIT,这是一个大规模细化的分类发现基准,其动力是分类学的分裂:一个曾经被认为是单一物种的现实过程,通过这个过程发现它包含多个不同的物种。 PS-SPLIT包含分布在全球的79K,高质量,群集的鸟类图像,覆盖771个物种,来源于最近257个真正的专家验证的分类分裂,具有相关的地理元数据和完整的分类等级. 实际分类分裂导致的类别之间的视觉差异可能非常微妙,往往需要大量的人类专门知识来区分,使PS-SPLIT成为一个具有挑战性的基准,我们希望这将有助于推进精细分类发现研究。 基于分类划分,我们引入了按分类划分的发现任务,目的是确定哪些已知的分类应该细分为新的精细分类. 我们调整了四种一般的类别发现方法,以适应这一环境,评价现有方法,并表明今后有很大的进展余地。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
It is now possible to train vision models to perform large-scale fine-grained visual categorization from labeled datasets spanning tens of thousands of possible categories.
However, conventional supervised training assumes that the training labels are mostly accurate and that the label distribution is static, i.e., the categories do not change.
In practice, the real world is more complex as new concepts are constantly being discovered or invented and existing concepts are being split into new ones.
This is visible across many domains, e.g., the rise of new fashion subcultures, the branching of musical genres, the evolution of linguistic and cultural categories, innovation in consumer products, and the discovery of new diseases in medicine.
The next frontier in computer vision is the development of models that can assist with this kind of open-ended concept discovery.
blocks.zh:
现在可以对视觉模型进行培训,以便从覆盖数以万计的可能类别的标签数据集中进行大规模精细的视觉分类。
然而,常规的受监督培训假设培训标签大多准确,且标签分布为静态,即类别不变.
实际上,现实世界更为复杂,因为新概念不断被发现或发明,现有概念被分解为新概念.
这在许多领域都可见一斑,例如:新时尚亚文化的兴起,音乐流派的分化,语言和文化类别的演变,消费品的创新,以及医学中新疾病的发现等.
计算机视觉的下一个前沿是开发能够协助这种开放式概念发现的模型.

The American Robin, which can be found across North America, has not been subject to any taxonomic splits.
In contrast, the Dusky Thrush was previously considered to be a subspecies of Naumann’s Thrush , but has subsequently been determined to be a distinct species based on appearance/morphological, geographic, and genetic cues [ 1 ] .
The world map shows the distribution of images in PS-SPLIT,
and locations where the individual birds depicted have been observed are denoted with colored circles in the regional maps.
blocks.zh:
图1:真实世界的视觉类可以随时间而分. 在此,我们从我们的PS-SPLIT数据集中说明两类数据。
北美各地都能发现的"美国罗宾"没有受到任何分类分化的影响.
相形之下,Dusky Thrush以前被认为是Naumann's Thrush的一个亚种,但后来根据外观/形态,地理学,和遗传暗示[1]被确定为独特的物种.
世界地图显示图片在PS-SPLIT的分布,
在区域地图中用彩色圆圈表示。

blocks.en:
A particularly clear instance of this challenge arises in biology.
Every year, scientists and nature enthusiasts discover thousands of new species [ 34 ] .
Many of these are not the result of some new, previously unobserved, organism being spotted in the wild for the first time.
Instead, they are the product of experts deducing that what was previously thought to be one species is in fact two or more (see example species split in Fig. 1 ).
A well-known recent example is the giraffe, previously thought to be one species, but now recognized as four distinct species illustrated by differences in their spot patterns [ 17 ] .
The ultimate decision to split a species is typically based on genetic information, but is supported by more easily obtainable cues such as morphological/appearance differences or their geographic distribution [ 12 ] .
Determining whether an existing species should be split is currently a very time-consuming task that requires significant domain expertise.
We envisage a complementary workflow whereby an automated system proposes potential species splits, that can then be later verified by human domain experts.
blocks.zh:
这种挑战的一个特别明显的例子是生物学。
每年科学家和自然爱好者都会发现上千个新物种[34].
其中许多并不是一些新的、以前没有观察到的生物第一次被发现在野外的结果。
相反,它们是专家推断以前认为一个物种实际上是两个或两个以上物种的产物(见图1中的物种分裂的例子)。
最近一个有名的例子是长颈鹿,它以前曾被认为是一个物种,但现在被承认为四个不同的物种,以它们的斑点模式的不同来说明. [17].
划分一个物种的最终决定通常基于遗传信息,但得到更容易获得的提示的支持,如形态/出现差异或其地理分布[12]。
确定一个现有物种是否应被分拆,目前是一项非常耗时的任务,需要大量领域的专门知识。
我们设想了一个互补的工作流程,一个自动化系统建议潜在的物种分裂,然后可由人类领域专家核查。

blocks.en:
To enable research on this problem, we introduce PS-SPLIT, a new fine-grained benchmark for category discovery built from real taxonomic splits.
PS-SPLIT contains 79K community-collected images of 771 bird species sourced from the citizen-science platform iNaturalist [ 24 ] .
It is organized around 257 taxonomic splits supported by scientific evidence that have been documented over the past 12 years.
Each split is also matched with 257 taxonomically similar non-splitting ‘control’ species.
We release PS-SPLIT in two versions: PS-SPLIT-Full, with all 257 splits, and PS-SPLIT-Small, a 64-split subset of a similar size to existing category discovery benchmarks.
Each observation/image also includes geographic metadata and full taxonomic hierarchy information.
As the categories arise from real taxonomic splits, i.e., from species that are so similar they were considered the same species until recently, visual differences can be very subtle and often require significant expertise to tell apart, making PS-SPLIT a very challenging benchmark for fine-grained category discovery.
blocks.zh:
为了能够对这个问题进行研究,我们引入了PS-SPLIT,这是由真正的分分类法构建的类别发现的一个新的精细分量基准.
PS-SPLIT收录了从公民-科学平台iNaturalist[24]所取出771个鸟类物种的79K社区采集图像.
其组织范围约为257个分类分裂,有过去12年来已有文献记载的科学证据支持.
每个分块还配有257个分类学上相似的非分块 " 控制 " 物种。
我们以两个版本发布PS-SPLIT:PS-SPLIT-Full,全部有257个分出;以及PS-SPLIT-Small,一个64个分出子集,大小与现有的类别发现基准相似.
每个观测/图像还包括地理元数据和完整的分类结构信息。
由于这些分类来源于真正的分类分化,即来自非常相近的物种,直到最近它们一直被认为是同一种物种,视觉差异可能非常微妙,往往需要大量的专门知识才能分辨,使得PS-SPLIT成为了精细分类发现的极具挑战性的基准.

blocks.en:
Inspired by taxonomic splitting, PS-SPLIT enables a new task, discovery by category splitting (DCS).
Our splitting task is related to existing category discovery work in computer vision [ 21 , 52 , 22 ] .
However, conventional category discovery methods typically explore the setting where a large number of labeled and unlabeled images are provided during training and the goal is to group the unlabeled images into new, or existing, categories.
In practice, we argue that a more realistic task involves taking images from existing categories and determining if they should be split into multiple new fine-grained categories, or not.
Our framing of the problem is also connected to non-discovery work that trains on coarse supervision and then tests on fine categories [ 41 , 45 ] .
However, unlike the majority of existing work that trains on coarse supervision, in our setting we cannot assume that all the coarse entities should be split into finer ones, i.e., only a small subset of existing categories are likely to be split into a new sub-categories.
Furthermore, we would also like to generalize to categories that were not observed at training time, i.e., the test categories may be disjoint from those in our training set.
blocks.zh:
在分类分裂的启发下,PS-SPLIT能够实现一个新的任务,通过分类分裂(DCS)来发现.
我们的分拆任务与计算机视觉的现有类别发现工作有关[21,52,22].
然而,传统的类别发现方法通常探索在培训期间提供大量标签和无标签图像的设置,目标是将未标签图像分为新的或现有的类别。
在实践中,我们主张,一个更现实的任务就是从现有类别中取出图像,并确定是否应该将其分为多个新的精细类别。
我们对这一问题的阐述也与非发现性工作有关,即进行粗细的监管,然后对细类进行测试[41,45]。
然而,与大多数进行粗细监督的现有工作不同,在我们的环境下,我们不能假定所有粗细的实体应被分成更细小的实体,即只有一小部分现有的类别有可能被分成一个新的子类别。
此外,我们还希望概括到在培训时没有观察到的类别,即测试类别可能与我们培训组中的类别脱节。

blocks.en:
We make the following contributions:
(i) We introduce PS-SPLIT, a large-scale fine-grained benchmark for category discovery comprising 79K bird images from 771 species organized around 257 expert-verified taxonomic splits and matched controls, with associated geographic and taxonomic metadata.
(ii) We formalize the task of discovery by category splitting , a new category-discovery task in which the model must decide, for each previously unseen coarse category, whether it should be split, into how many new categories, and which images belongs to which new category.
(iii) Detailed evaluation, where we adapt and benchmark existing category discovery methods on PS-SPLIT, in addition to performing experiments on new category splitting versions of three existing fine-grained datasets (CUB-200-2011, Stanford Cars, and FGVC Aircraft).
blocks.zh:
我们作出以下贡献:
(一) 我们采用PS-SPLIT,这是大规模细化的类别发现基准,包括来自771个物种的79K鸟类图像,大约257个经专家核实的分类分解和相应的控制,以及相关的地理和分类元数据。
(二)我们正式确定按类别划分的发现任务,这是一个新的类别发现任务,其中模型必须决定,对于以前不见的粗细的类别,是否应该分为多少个新类别,哪些图像属于哪个新类别.
(三)详细评价,在PS-SPLIT上,我们除了对现有三个精细刻度数据集(CUB-200-2011,斯坦福汽车和FGVC Aircraft)进行新分类分拆版本的实验外,还对现有类别发现方法进行了调整和基准.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Category Discovery. Given a set of labeled and unlabeled images, category discovery methods aim to group images from the unlabeled set into novel categories [ 22 ] .
The task differs from unsupervised clustering in that the labeled images provide guidance as to what features are informative for forming categories.
Different variants of the problem have been proposed, e.g., where the unlabeled data only contains images from novel categories [ 21 , 18 ] , where it contains a mix of novel and previously seen categories [ 52 , 6 , 55 ] , or where discovery is performed in an online/incremental [ 63 , 62 ] or non-transductive [ 16 ] setting.
Most methods typically assume that the number of novel categories is known [ 20 , 18 , 55 ] , but there are also approaches for estimating the number using limited human supervision [ 39 ] or in a completely unsupervised manner [ 18 , 52 , 64 ] .
Graph-based discovery methods [ 61 , 37 , 7 , 57 ] have also been proposed that use graph clustering techniques [ 7 , 57 ] to automatically estimate the number of categories present.
Concurrent to our work, [ 29 ] introduce a category-splitting task for fine-grained video understanding where coarse categories learned by pre-trained models are refined into finer ones.
Unlike our setting, they are given the coarse category to split and the names of its subcategories, and every evaluated category is split. We instead must decide, without names or labels, whether each unseen coarse category splits and into how many. In our experiments we adapt several existing generalized category discovery methods and demonstrate that they struggle on PS-SPLIT.
blocks.zh:
分类发现. 鉴于一组有标签和无标签的图像,分类发现方法旨在将未标签的图像组合成新的类别[22].
这项任务不同于未经监督的集群,因为被标注的图像提供了指导,说明哪些特征对组成类别具有信息性。
对这个问题提出了不同的变体,例如,未贴标签的数据只包含从小说类别[21,18]的图像,其中包含有新颖和以前见过的类别[52,6,55]的组合,或者在在线/递增[63,62]或非递译[16]设置中进行发现.
大多数方法通常假定新颖类别的数量是已知的[20,18,55],但也有使用有限的人监督[39]或完全不受监督的方式估计数量的方法[18,52,64].
还提出了基于图表的发现方法[61、37、7、57],即使用图表集群技术[7、57]自动估计所存在的类别。
在工作的同时,[29]引入了分类分拆任务,用于精细的视频理解,通过预先训练过的模型所学到的粗细的类别被精细地提炼为精细的.
与我们的设定不同,它们被赋予粗细的分类来分出,并被分出其子类的名称,每个被评价的分类都被分出. 相反,我们必须在没有名称或标签的情况下,决定是否将每一个看不见的粗糙类别分成几个。 在我们的实验中,我们调整了几种现有的通用类发现方法,并表明它们与PS-SPLIT有斗争.

blocks.en:
Learning from coarse supervision. Our problem setting also relates to learning from coarse supervision, a task which has been explored under several different settings.
The first is where only coarse labels are available at training time, but the test set contains finer instances of these coarse categories [ 23 , 56 , 48 ] . [ 56 , 48 ] both make use of a non-parametric memory bank which is learned from coarse supervision and fine-grained instances are compared to it using a nearest neighbor look-up at inference time.
In the second setting, coarse labels are available for all images at training time, but a small subset of those images also have finer labels [ 41 , 45 ] . [ 44 ] explored a hierarchical semi-supervised setting where coarse labels were again provided for all images and finer labels only for some, but there were also additional ‘out-of-class’ distractor categories in the training set without fine labels.
Few-shot techniques have also been proposed that first train on coarse labels and then evaluate using a small number of fine-grained labels [ 58 , 5 ] .
Finally, there are approaches that combine coarse label supervision with finer-grained language information obtained from text knowledge bases [ 10 ] .
Unlike our setting, coarsely supervised methods typically assume that the label space in the train and test sets is the same.
Specifically, the test set contains a more granular (i.e., finer-grained) splitting of the training labels.
In our setting, test categories may be novel and not observed during training.
blocks.zh:
学习粗放监督. 我们的问题背景也涉及从粗糙的监督中学习,这是在几个不同环境下探讨过的任务。
第一种情况是在训练时只有粗糙的标签,但试验集中包含这些粗糙类的更细小的例子[23,56,48]. [56,48] 两种情况都使用从粗糙监督学来的非参数存储库,而精细的刻度则使用最近的邻居在推断时间进行对比.
在第二种设定中,所有图像在训练时都有粗糙的标签,但其中一小部分的图像也有更细细的标签[41,45]. [44] 探索了一种分级半监督的设定,对所有图像和更细的标签只为部分人提供粗糙的标签,但是在训练时也增加了 " 班外 " 分心者类别,没有细细的标签。
也有人提出少发技术,先用粗口标签进行列车,再用少量细口标签来评价. [58, 5].
最后,有些方法将粗糙的标签监督与从文本知识库获得的精细语言信息相结合[10].
与我们的设定不同,粗糙的被监督的方法通常假定列车和测试机组中的标签空间是相同的.
具体地说,测试集包含一个更颗粒(即更细纹的)分出训练标签.
在我们的环境下,测试类别可能是新颖的,在训练期间没有被观察到.

blocks.en:
Geographic priors. Knowing where an image was taken can help determine which category is depicted in it.
Combining location information with image classifiers can significantly improve classification performance [ 47 , 31 , 11 ] .
One approach is to train a separate image classifier and spatial prior, i.e., a model that predicts the likelihood of a category being present given a location, via non-parametric [ 4 ] or learning-based methods [ 31 , 14 , 43 ] .
Alternatively, methods that fuse location information into the image classifier during training have also been proposed [ 47 , 11 , 59 ] .
These methods enable the model to learn how to combine the information from the two different sources.
Our experiments show that intermediate feature representations encoded by existing spatial priors such as [ 14 ] are helpful for splitting bird species that are present in PS-SPLIT.
blocks.zh:
地理学名著. 了解图像拍摄地点有助于确定其中的哪一类别。
将位置信息与图像分级器合并,可以显著地改善分类性能[47,31,11].
一种方法是通过非参数方法[4]或基于学习的方法[31、14、43],培训一个单独的图像分类器和空间前,即一种模型,预测某一类别存在某一地点的可能性。
或者,还提出了在培训期间将位置信息纳入图像分类器的方法[47、11、59]。
这些方法使模型能够学习如何将来自两个不同来源的信息结合起来.
我们的实验表明,由[14]等现有空间前科编码的中间特征表示有助于分离PS-SPLIT中存在的鸟类物种。

blocks.en:
Fine-grained category discovery benchmarks. Category discovery methods are typically evaluated on a small set of standard fine-grained vision datasets, namely CUB-200-2011 [ 54 ] , Stanford Cars [ 26 ] , FGVC Aircraft [ 32 ] , and Herbarium19 [ 46 ] , along with less fine-grained datasets such as CIFAR-10/100 [ 27 ] .
None of these were designed for the discovery setting, often producing tasks that saturate quickly, e.g., performance on CIFAR-10 is near-perfect, and headroom on the other benchmarks is shrinking.
PS-SPLIT is intended to complement these benchmarks with a fine-grained, naturally hierarchical, and substantially harder evaluation setting whose coarse–fine structure is grounded in real taxonomic decisions.
Ultra-fine-grained recognition benchmarks [ 60 ] target categories that even experts find hard to separate (e.g., plant cultivars). In contrast, PS-SPLIT has a defined label hierarchy determined by established species taxonomy, and the task involves discovering whether a category should be split.
blocks.zh:
精细分类发现基准. 分类发现方法一般在一小组标准细纹视觉数据集上评价,即CUB-200-2011 [54],斯坦福车 [26],FGVC Aircraft [32],和Herbarium19 [46],以及CIFAR-10/100 [27]等细纹数据集.
这些都不是为发现设置而设计的,往往产生快速饱和的任务,例如CIFAR-10上的性能接近完美,其他基准上的头室正在收缩.
PS-SPLIT旨在用精细的、自然的分级的和更严格的评价设定来补充这些基准,而粗糙的-精细结构是基于真正的分类决定的。
超精致的识别基准[60]甚至专家都难以区分的目标类别(如植物栽培物等). 相形之下,PS-SPLIT具有由已确立的物种分类学确定的被定义的标签等级,任务涉及发现一个类别是否应被分拆.

blocks.en:
Biodiversity image benchmarks. A complementary line of work has built large-scale ecology and biodiversity image datasets for primarily evaluating classification.
The iNaturalist Challenge datasets [ 50 , 49 ] span thousands of species across plants, animals, and fungi, and were later adapted for incremental category discovery in [ 63 ] .
BIOSCAN-5M [ 19 ] pairs images with DNA barcodes for insect taxonomy.
Closer to discovery, Open-Insect [ 9 ] introduces an open-set recognition benchmark for novel insect species across geographic regions.
These benchmarks emphasize scale and coverage and do contain visually very similar species, with many insect species in BIOSCAN-5M being visually indistinguishable.
CrypticBio [ 33 ] collates visually confusing species based on past user misidentifications on iNaturalist and evaluates vision-language models on classifying them.
PS-SPLIT also contains visually similar species, but selects them based on documented taxonomic changes, and focuses on category splitting rather than classification.
PS-SPLIT complements these existing datasets by targeting the question of when a known coarse category should itself be subdivided into finer ones, grounded in documented expert-defined taxonomic splits.
blocks.zh:
生物多样性形象基准。 一项补充性的工作为主要评价分类建立了大规模生态和生物多样性图像数据集。
iNaturalist挑战数据集[50,49]跨植物,动物,真菌等数千个物种,后被改编为增量类发现[63].
BIOSCAN-5M [19] 有DNA条码的成对图像用于昆虫分类学.
更接近于发现,开口昆虫[9]引入了跨地理区域新颖昆虫物种的开口识别基准.
这些基准强调规模和覆盖范围,确实包含视觉上非常相近的物种,BIOSCAN-5M中的许多昆虫物种在视觉上无法区分.
CrypticBio [33]根据过去用户在iNaturalist上的误认来整理视觉混乱物种,并评价视向语言模型对其分类.
PS-SPLIT也包含视觉相近的物种,但根据文献记载的分类变化来选择它们,并注重分类分出而非分出.
PS-SPLIT通过针对一个已知粗细的类别本身何时应再细分为更细细的类别的问题,以有文献记载的专家定义的分类法划分为基础,来补充这些现有数据集。

blocks.en: 3 The PS-SPLIT Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3. PS-SPLIT基准

blocks.en:
We introduce PS-SPLIT, a new fine-grained benchmark for category splitting built from real taxonomic splits documented on the citizen science platform iNaturalist [ 24 ] over the past 12 years.
Each split contributes a coarse class (the previously accepted species), along with the two newly recognized fine species.
In addition, each split is paired with a taxonomically close control coarse class that has not undergone a split.
Throughout, a coarse class is the category before any split and a fine class is a currently accepted species. Control coarse classes have not undergone a splitting event, so their coarse and fine labels coincide.
The control design ensures that splitting decisions cannot be predicted from coarse-category size, broad taxonomic group, or geographic footprint alone.
PS-SPLIT contains 79,061 research-grade (i.e., verified) bird images across 771 species drawn from 257 splits and 257 matched controls, with per-image latitude/longitude metadata and full taxonomic hierarchy (order, family, genus). Fig. 2 shows example images and locations for a taxonomic split included in PS-SPLIT, including small visual differences that may allow this split to be detected.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了PS-SPLIT,这是在过去12年里从公民科学平台iNaturalist [24] 上记录的真正的分类分裂中构建的一个新的细微分级基准.
每分出一分就贡献出一分粗细的种类(之前被接受的物种),连同两个被新承认的细细的物种.
此外,每分出一分还配有没有发生分出情况的分类相近控制粗细类.
在整个过程中,粗细类是任何分出之前的分类,而细细类是目前被接受的物种. 控制粗劣的阶层没有经历分拆事件,所以它们的粗糙而细微的标签是吻合的.
控制设计确保无法从粗细的类别大小、广泛的分类组别或仅地理足迹来预测分裂决定。
PS-SPLIT包含79,061个研究级(即经核实)从257个分出和257个相匹配的控取出771个物种的鸟类图像,并有每个图像的纬度/经度元数据和完整的分类等级(顺序,家族,基因). 图2显示了PS-SPLIT中包含的分类分裂的图像和位置,包括小的视觉差异,这些差异可能允许检测到这种分裂.

blocks.en:
Dataset construction. We source data from research-grade observations, i.e., community verified images with associated metadata, on iNaturalist.
Research-grade observations only require community agreement on taxonomic identity, but the images themselves could be of very low quality.
As a result, additional filtering is needed to obtain a discriminative fine-grained dataset.
PS-SPLIT is built using five processing stages: (i) split and control selection from the iNaturalist taxonomic-changes feed [ 25 ] (two-way splits with at least 20 research-grade observations per generated species; controls drawn from the same genus or family with similar observation counts and never having undergone a taxonomic change themselves.
We use binary splits as they are the most common, i.e., at the time of writing there were 1,208 binary vs. 425 multi-way species-level splits on iNaturalist since 2012.
To evaluate category splitting approaches outside the binary setting, we also adapt existing fine-grained datasets to have multi-way splits ( Sec. 6 ). (ii) image cap with user diversification , retaining up to 100 images per species and preferring distinct uploaders/users so no single user’s photography style dominates. (iii) an object detector to remove small instances , retaining detections from MegaDetector [ 3 ] with animal-class confidence ≥ \geq 0.75 and shortest bounding-box edge ≥ \geq 190 px, then resizing each crop to 256 × \times 256. (iv) a vision–language quality filter (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 2 ] ) that scores seven binary criteria (bird present, adult, not obscured, in focus, no text/watermark, no particularly unusual images, and no other prominent animals) and assigns a coarse bird pose label, with pose consistency enforced across species produced from a taxonomic split so that a split decision cannot be made simply because one species is photographed in a particular pose more often. (v) A visual-difference screen in which a DINOv2 [ 36 ] linear probe trained on 20% of each species pair’s images must exceed 60% accuracy on classifying the remaining data for that pair of species, removing species that are visually indistinguishable and may have been split using non-visual information (e.g., genetic information may be required to determine the split).
In practice this only removes 6 of the 263 (2.3%) candidate taxonomic splits as most bird (i.e., aves) taxonomic splits do involve subtle visual differences.
As this filter relies on a pretrained representation, we analyze its potential for selection bias in Appendix F.1 : method rankings remain stable under stricter thresholds (Spearman ρ = 0.96 \rho=0.96 at 0.70, and 0.78 0.78 at 0.90, which discards 62.6% of coarse classes).
Additional details of our processing pipeline, including prompt templates, and worked examples are provided in Appendix D .

Statistics. Table 1 reports the top-level statistics of PS-SPLIT.
By construction, every splitting coarse class is paired with a control coarse class of nearly identical image count (mean | Δ | ≈ 2 |\Delta|\!\approx\!2 images per pair).
Half of the pairs are then assigned as ‘known’, where the fine classes are available during training, with the rest assigned as ‘novel’ where the number of fine classes is unknown.
PS-SPLIT comes in two versions: PS-SPLIT-Full, which contains all 257 splits and controls, and a smaller PS-SPLIT-Small subset (25,285 images, 192 species, 64 splits + 64 controls) for budget-constrained evaluation, roughly matching the size of existing benchmarks for category discovery.
The full PS-SPLIT dataset spans 22 orders, 94 families, and 262 genera.
Geographic coverage is global, weighted toward South and Southeast Asia (19.8%), South America (15.8%), and North America (12.3%).
Density heatmaps and per-country totals are in Appendix G , with full taxonomic coverage in Appendix H .

blocks.en:
Compared to datasets such as CUB-200-2011 [ 54 ] , Stanford Cars [ 26 ] , FGVC Aircraft [ 32 ] , PS-SPLIT is larger, and has a coarse–fine taxonomy that arises from real documented species-level taxonomic splits, ensuring that fine categories are very visually similar and challenging to separate, and provides geographic metadata.
These properties support the discovery by splitting task we introduce in Sec. 4 and provide a natural setting for evaluating geographic priors when visual classification is challenging.

blocks.en:
Licensing, intended use, and known biases. All included observations are research-grade iNaturalist records under licenses that permit redistribution for research.
PS-SPLIT is intended for benchmarking fine-grained category discovery and category-splitting algorithms.
It should not be used as a source of ground-truth taxonomic decisions.
The dataset inherits biases from its citizen-science source, e.g., the distribution of bird observations in PS-SPLIT correlates with the distribution of observers rather than the true distribution of bird species, and some regions of the globe contain few iNaturalist contributors and splits or control species in these locations may not have enough suitable images to be included in the dataset.
This leads to some regions with very few observations, as shown in Appendix G .
The image cap and user-diversity preference flatten the distribution bias but do not remove broader geographic/taxonomic skews ( Sec. 7 ).
The full dataset is available at https://github.com/PS-SPLIT/PSSPLIT .

blocks.en: 4 The Discovery by Category Splitting Task
blocks.zh: 4 按分类拆分任务的发现

blocks.en: Here we introduce our category splitting task which is the basis of our evaluation on PS-SPLIT.
blocks.zh: 在此,我们介绍我们分类的划分任务,这是我们评价PS-SPLIT的基础。

blocks.en:
Inputs and outputs. At training time, the model sees a known set of coarse classes with two levels of label granularity per instance: a coarse label y c y^{c} (the previously accepted category, before any split) and a fine label y f y^{f} (the currently accepted category, after splitting).
Instances within a coarse class that splits into new species share y c y^{c} but may have different y f y^{f} , while all instances within a non-splitting coarse class share the same y f y^{f} .
In the case of PS-SPLIT, each image instance additionally has geographic metadata 𝐳 i = ( lat i , lon i ) \mathbf{z}_{i}=(\text{lat}_{i},\text{lon}_{i}) .
At test time, the model is given a disjoint set of previously unseen coarse classes, each represented by its instances and their optional metadata.
For every test coarse class the model must decide (i) whether the class should be split, (ii) the number of fine classes K K if it does, and (iii) the assignment of each image instance to a new fine class, if it splits.

Protocol. On PS-SPLIT we adopt a 50/50 known/novel split at the level of aligned coarse-class pairs such that each splitting class is paired with a control, and each pair is assigned in its entirety to either the known (training) or novel (test) partition ( Table 1 ).
This ensures the test partition contains a balanced mix of classes that should split and classes that should not, and that a model cannot exploit splitting/control imbalance during training.
The maximum cardinality to predict per coarse class is K max = 2 K_{\text{max}}=2 for PS-SPLIT, since all included splits are two-way (for cases where a split occurs).

Evaluation metrics. We report performance using multiple metrics. Clustering accuracy (Cl. Acc) is the standard Hungarian-aligned accuracy of fine-label assignment [ 21 ] , computed per coarse class and macro-averaged. AMI is the corresponding adjusted-mutual-information score.
We also report split-only variants (Cl. Acc s , AMI s ) restricted to coarse classes with true cardinality K ∗ > 1 K^{*}\!>\!1 , since these are the cases where the model has actually been asked to discover structure.
Multiple metrics are needed because simple baselines can perform well on one metric while being useless for the discovery by category splitting task, e.g., never splitting achieves perfect accuracy on every control class (Appendix A ). K accuracy (K Acc) is the smooth score 1 / ( 1 + | K ^ − K ∗ | ) 1/(1+|\hat{K}-K^{*}|) averaged over all coarse classes, with split-only variant K Acc s . Δ ​ ∑ K = ∑ K ^ − ∑ K ∗ \Delta\!\sum\!K\;=\;\sum\hat{K}-\sum K^{*} is the signed deviation of the total predicted fine class count from the truth, indicating whether a method tends to over- or under-split.
Finally, Split Precision is the precision of the binary “this coarse class should be split” decision; of the coarse classes the model predicts as multi-fine, the fraction whose true cardinality is indeed greater than one.

blocks.en: 5 Category Splitting Methods
blocks.zh: 5类 拆分方法

blocks.en:
We benchmark several methods on PS-SPLIT, organized into four families: visual backbones, geographic features, K estimation, and downstream clustering.
All baselines share the same overall pipeline: extract features for each instance from a visual backbone f θ f_{\theta} (optionally concatenated with a geographic feature from a location encoder g ϕ g_{\phi} ), estimate the number of fine classes K K for each test coarse class, then cluster the features into K K groups.
Additional architecture and training details can be found in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
我们以PS-SPLIT为基准,将几种方法分为四个家庭:视觉骨干、地理特征、K估计和下游集群。
所有基线共用相同的总体管道:从一个视觉主干线 f → f_{\theta}(从一个位置编码器 gφg_{\phi} 中可选地取出地理特征)中提取每个实例的特性,估计每个测试粗细类的精细类 K K 的数量,然后将特性分组为 K 组.
其他建筑和培训细节见附录E。

blocks.en:
Visual backbones. We evaluate six backbones, all ViT-B-based so that they remain comparable.
A frozen DINOv1 [ 8 ] and a frozen DINOv2 [ 36 ] with registers [ 15 ] serve as references that require no training.
We then fine-tune the DINOv2 with registers on the known coarse classes of PS-SPLIT using the following category discovery methods: GCD [ 52 ] , SimGCD [ 55 ] , UNO+ [ 18 ] , and SelEx [ 40 ] .
This yields four trained backbones whose representations are tuned to fine-grained taxonomic distinctions seen during training.
The frozen and trained DINOv2 variants share the same pre-trained weights, so any improvement reflects fine-tuning rather than initialization.
All trained backbones are image-only, i.e., they do not receive any location information during training.

视觉骨干. 我们评价6个骨干,所有基于ViT-B的骨干,使其保持可比性.

blocks.en:
Geographic features. Where geographic metadata is available, we use a SINR [ 14 ] location encoder trained with the AN_FULL loss on the location training data from [ 14 ] to produce a feature vector per observation based on the location the image was taken.
This is then concatenated with the visual feature from f θ f_{\theta} before downstream K K estimation and clustering.
SINR is treated as a frozen feature extractor and is not fine-tuned on PS-SPLIT.
Location information only enters the pipeline at the K-estimation and clustering stages, so the “w/o Geo” results are a location ablation of the pipeline.

blocks.en:
K estimation. We also compare three families of methods for predicting the number of fine classes per test coarse class. Tuning-based methods select K K and perform clustering for each test class by tuning a single global hyperparameter on the known classes: Tuning-Agglo sweeps the agglomerative-clustering distance threshold, Tuning-Spectral sweeps the spectral-eigengap threshold [ 35 , 53 ] , and Tuning-XMeans sweeps the PCA dimension before X-Means [ 38 ] selects K K via BIC. Brent-based methods cluster a set of coarse classes with known fine classes and instances from an unknown coarse class jointly at varying K K and sweep through various values of K K to find the K K at which a held-out portion of the known data is best clustered, as in the K-estimator from GCD [ 52 ] .
Pairing this estimator with KMeans, agglomerative, spectral, and GMM clustering yields four Brent-X variants.
The Brent method with KMeans on a GCD backbone is typically used in generalized category discovery approaches that require the number of unknown classes to be known before training, as in SimGCD [ 55 ] and SelEx [ 40 ] .
Finally, we also introduce a Transformer K estimator , which is a lightweight 2-layer 8-head transformer [ 51 ] that takes all available backbone features from a coarse class as input and outputs a CLS token which is input to a cardinality predictor head that predicts K K .
It has roughly 500K parameters and trains in around ten minutes on a single A6000 GPU for the full PS-SPLIT.
Further details are provided in Appendix E .
We additionally report an Oracle as an upper bound that uses the true K ∗ K^{*} .
We do not include UNO+ or SimGCD parametric classification directly, as their training method assumes K K is known a priori, so we use these approaches as feature extractors for the K-estimation methods we do compare.

与KMEANs对等的这个估计器, 具有巨型、光谱和GMM群集, 产生四个 Brent-X 变体。

它拥有大约500K参数,并在大约10分钟内在为全PS-SPLIT的A6000GPU上进行列车.
详见附录E。

我们不直接包括UNO+或SimGCD参数分类,因为他们的训练方法假定K K是先验的,所以我们使用这些方法作为我们比较的K-估计方法的特征提取器.

blocks.en: 6 Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: 6. 基准结果

blocks.en:
We benchmark the methods described in Sec. 5 on PS-SPLIT, training each method on the known coarse classes and reporting metrics on the held-out novel classes.
Implementation details for the inherited backbones follow their original publications.
We report results on PS-SPLIT-Small in the main paper, and the corresponding results for PS-SPLIT-Full and our adapted fine-grained datasets can be found in Appendix A .

我们在PS-SPLIT上将第5节所述方法作为基准,对每种方法进行已知粗劣课的培训,并对被搁置的小说课进行汇报。
继承骨干的执行细节沿用其原始出版物.
我们在主要论文中报告PS-SPLIT-Small的结果,PS-SPLIT-Full和我们经过调整的精细纹理数据集的相应结果载于附录A。

blocks.en:
Headline results. PS-SPLIT is a challenging benchmark.
On PS-SPLIT-Small, the best non-oracle method reaches Cl. Acc. of 0.78 0.78 against an oracle ceiling of 0.93 0.93 – 0.94 0.94 , a gap of roughly fifteen clustering-accuracy points ( Table 3 ).
On PS-SPLIT-Full ( Table A3 ), the gap closes to roughly eleven points ( 0.82 0.82 vs. 0.93 0.93 ).
Predicting that every coarse class does not split would achieve roughly 0.75 0.75 clustering accuracy, as this would get perfect performance on the non-splitting control classes, and approximately 50% on the splitting classes, due to the relatively balanced splitting fine class sizes.
However split-only Cl. Acc s would only be  50% and AMI s would be 0.
Lower-bound baselines (Never-Split, Always-Split, and Random+KMeans) are reported in Tables A2 and A3 in the Appendix.
None is competitive across all metrics, e.g., Never-Split has AMI s = 0.00 {}_{s}=0.00 and undefined Split Precision, while Always-Split over-splits every control ( Δ ​ ∑ K = + 32 \Delta\!\sum\!K=+32 , Split Precision 0.50 0.50 ).
Among the strongest configurations we observe are the transformer K-estimator paired with either DINOv2 or SelEx plus SINR features, but they sit well below the oracle.

Effect of geographic information. Adding geographic features raises the oracle Cl. Acc. from 0.83 0.83 – 0.85 0.85 to 0.93 0.93 – 0.94 0.94 regardless of whether the visual backbone is default DINOv2 or the SelEx fine-tuned version.

The non-oracle methods recover only part of this headroom, but consistently improve in the same direction.
For example, on PS-SPLIT-Small the transformer’s Δ ​ ∑ K \Delta\!\sum\!K moves toward zero on both DINOv2 ( + → + 0 +7\!\to\!+0 ) and SelEx ( + → + 4 +24\!\to\!+4 ); on the full dataset the analogous shifts are larger ( + → + 30 +57\!\to\!+30 on DINOv2 and + → − 12 +118\!\to\!-12 on SelEx).

This demonstrates that there is indeed sufficient visual signal in the images to split the categories.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Real splitting decisions are not strictly visual. The underlying assumption of PS-SPLIT is that real taxonomic splits provide evidence in image and location data that a model can recover.
In practice, while a candidate split can be hypothesized from visual and geographic cues, genetic evidence is the ultimate arbiter of species delimitation [ 42 ] .
Methods evaluated on PS-SPLIT should therefore only be used to propose candidate splits for downstream expert review and genetic confirmation, not as a substitute for taxonomic decisions.
We do not use genetic data as it is less widely available than images and locations, and is not available for all species.
We leave this extension for future work.
blocks.zh:
真正的分裂决定不是严格意义上的。 PS-SPLIT的基本假设是,真实的分类分裂在图像和位置数据中提供了一个模型可以恢复的证据.
在实践中,虽然从视觉和地理角度可以假设一个候选分裂,但遗传证据是物种划界的最终仲裁者[42].
因此,在PS-SPLIT上评价的方法只应用于提出下游专家审查和基因确认的候选分裂,而不是取而代之的分类决定。
我们不使用遗传数据,因为遗传数据比图像和地点的普及程度要低,而且并非所有物种都能得到。
我们把这个延期留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
Birds only. PS-SPLIT is restricted to birds to focus an already challenging task on a taxonomic group where sufficiently high quality data is available.
Birds account for 38% of the iNaturalist taxa with reported splits; are heavily observed, so split information is more reliable; they have a well-defined and stable taxonomy (unlike e.g., plants); and using a single taxonomic group enables the learning of fine-grained visual features that generalize across species.
The limitation is that generalization to other taxa is not directly evaluated in PS-SPLIT, although our adapted versions of Stanford Cars and FGVC Aircraft provide non-bird evaluations of the same task (Appendix A ).
Multimodal biodiversity datasets such as BIOSCAN-5M [ 19 ] could complement PS-SPLIT with genetic evidence and taxonomic coverage of very different organisms.
blocks.zh:
只有鸟。 PS-SPLIT仅限于鸟类,将本已具有挑战性的任务集中于拥有足够高质量数据的分类组。
鸟类占有报告分化的iNaturalist分类的38%;被大量观测到,因此分化信息更加可靠;它们有定义明确而稳定的分类学(与植物不同);使用单一分类学组可以学习通俗地跨物种的精细分化视觉特征.
其限制在于,在PS-SPLIT中不直接评价通向其他分类,尽管我们改编的斯坦福汽车和FGVC Aircraft提供了对同一项任务的非鸟类评价(附录A.
BIOSCAN-5M等多式生物多样性数据集[19]可以用基因证据和对非常不同的生物的分类覆盖来补充PS-SPLIT.

blocks.en:
Two-way splits only. We restrict to two-way splits and set K max = 2 K_{\max}=2 accordingly.
Most recent taxonomic decisions reported on iNaturalist are two-way, but some are not (e.g., the giraffe example in Sec. 1 resolved into four species).
The methods we evaluated could predict K > 2 K>2 but we do not provide examples for K > 2 K>2 for PS-SPLIT due to the limited number of species that would be available for training and evaluation.
However, our adapted fine-grained datasets do contain multi-way splits (up to K = 30 K=30 ; Appendix A ).
Hierarchical splitting across taxonomic levels [ 30 ] is another extension, though most taxonomic splits occur at the species level.

blocks.en:
Citizen-science biases. PS-SPLIT inherits well-documented biases of citizen science data.
Bias towards certain taxonomic groups is one, i.e., birds are highly observed which simplifies dataset construction, but limits generalization outside of this group.
Observation density correlates with contributor density rather than habitat density — dense coverage in North America and Western Europe, but sparse in large parts of central Africa and Asia (Appendix G ).
Splits are also more likely to have sufficient observations when the new species are clearly geographically separable as the new species labels can be automatically assigned to each observation based on location, while less geographically clear splits require per image manual review.
This may bias PS-SPLIT toward geography-dependent cases.
We analyze the regional effect of geographic features in Appendix F.2 .
Our VLM quality filter may also reduce intra-species variation, but we found it necessary given the uncurated iNaturalist images, and did not observe significant biases beyond it being slightly conservative ( Fig. A4 ).
blocks.zh:
公民科学偏见. PS-SPLIT继承了对公民科学数据有充分记载的偏见.
对某些分类组群的偏差是其中之一,即鸟类被高度观测,从而简化了数据集构造,但限制了该组群之外的通论.
观测密度与贡献者密度而不是生境密度有关——北美和西欧的覆盖率很高,而中非和亚洲大部分地区则很少(附录G)。
当新物种在地理上明显可分化时,分化也更有可能获得足够的观测,因为新物种标签可以根据位置自动分配给每个观测,而地理上不太清晰的分化则需要每个图像人工审查.
这可能使PS-SPLIT偏向于依赖地理的案例。
我们分析附录F.2中地理特征的区域影响。
我们的VLM质量滤波器也可能减少物种内部的变异,但鉴于iNaturalist图像未经校验,我们认为有必要这样做,而且除了略微保守外,没有观察到明显的偏差(图A4)。

blocks.en:
Control matching is taxonomic, not ecological or visual. Controls are matched at the genus or family level with similar observation counts, but we do not match for ecological niche, habitat type, or photographic difficulty.
Controls are not required to be visually indistinguishable from their splitting species, but being taxonomically close they are typically visually similar, which prevents learning shortcuts such as “all ducks should be split”.
blocks.zh:
控制匹配是分类学,而不是生态学或视觉学. 控制在基因或家族层面与类似的观测计数相匹配,但我们并不匹配生态优势,栖息地类型,或相片难度.
控制不一定要与被分割的物种在视觉上无法区分,但分类上接近它们通常具有相近的视觉特征,从而无法学习“所有鸭子都应被分割”等捷径。

blocks.en:
Splitting only. PS-SPLIT focuses exclusively on taxonomic splitting.
In practice, in some instances, taxonomic decisions also merge previously distinct species, and some of our control species may undergo a future split or merge.
We leave the merging counterpart of this task, and the joint split–merge setting, to future work.
blocks.zh:
仅分取. PS-SPLIT只专注于分类分化.
实际上,在某些情况下,分类学决定也合并了以前不同的物种,而我们的一些控制物种可能会在未来发生分裂或合并.
我们把这项任务的合并对应方和共同的分裂环境留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced PS-SPLIT, a fine-grained benchmark for category discovery built from 257 real taxonomic splits documented on iNaturalist, paired with 257 matched non-splitting controls and per-image geographic metadata.
Together with the dataset we formalized discovery by category splitting , a task in which a model must decide whether each previously unseen coarse class should be subdivided, into one or more fine classes, and how the data instances should be assigned.
We benchmarked several distinct discovery methods with two no-training references, three K-estimation families, and a lightweight transformer K-estimator we contribute alongside the dataset.
No method we evaluated approaches the oracle upper bound, demonstrating that PS-SPLIT is harder than the fine-grained discovery datasets it was designed to complement.
We hope PS-SPLIT and the discovery by splitting task will support sustained progress on more open-ended category discovery methods that are better aligned with challenging real-world problems.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了PS-SPLIT,这是从iNaturalist上记录的257个真实分类分解中构建的分类发现的精细分量基准,配对了257个匹配的非分量控制和每个图像的地理元数据.
与我们通过分类拆分正式发现的数据集一起,一个模型必须决定,是否应该将先前未见的粗细类分为一个或多个细小类,以及如何分配数据实例。
我们用两个不训练参考文献 三个K-估计家族 和一个轻量级变压器K-估计器 与数据集并列。
我们所评价的没有任何方法接近甲骨文上方的束缚,表明PS-SPLIT比它设计用来补充的精细的发现数据集更难.
我们希望PS-SPLIT和通过划分任务而发现将有助于在更加开放的类别发现方法方面取得持续进展,这些方法更能与挑战性的现实世界问题相配合。

This appendix reports the backbone, K-estimation, and clustering comparisons used in Sec. 6 on (i) the full PS-SPLIT, and (ii) three adapted fine-grained datasets that have no geographic metadata.
The full-PS-SPLIT results in Tables A1 and A3 extend the small-subset comparisons of Tables 2 and 3 ; the FG-dataset results in Tables A5 and A6 characterise how PS-SPLIT compares to existing fine-grained category-discovery benchmarks under the same evaluation protocol.

本附录报告了第6章中使用的关于(一) 完整的PS-SPLIT和(二) 三个没有地理元数据的经过调整的精细刻度数据集的主干、K-估计和集群比较。

blocks.en:
Backbone comparison on the full dataset. The eight-backbone comparison on the full PS-SPLIT ( Table A1 ) mirrors the small-subset patterns of Table 2 : visual-only backbones cluster within a narrow band (Cl. Acc. 0.65 0.65 – 0.80 0.80 across both K-estimators), and concatenating SINR geographic features improves all metrics under both K-estimators.
Two findings deserve highlighting on the full dataset.
First, the SINR-only baseline is among the strongest configurations regardless of K-estimator (Cl. Acc. 0.81 0.81 under Brent-KMeans, 0.79 0.79 under the transformer; Cl. Acc. s 0.71 0.71 and 0.79 0.79 respectively), reinforcing the conclusion that geography alone carries a portion of the distinguishing signal in PS-SPLIT, possibly as many images on iNaturalist are relabeled after a taxonomic split by the geographic region that the image is from, ensuring geographic information is useful for this task.
Second, several visual-only backbones under Brent + KMeans collapse close to a “never split” regime.
UNO+ is the most extreme: it reaches Cl. Acc. 0.80 0.80 purely by under-predicting splits ( Δ ​ ∑ K = − 124 \Delta\!\sum\!K=-124 , with predicted total K K only marginally above the no-split lower bound), and the handful of splits it does predict are all incorrect (Split Prec. 0.00 0.00 ).
SimGCD shows the same pattern in milder form ( Δ ​ ∑ K = − 118 \Delta\!\sum\!K=-118 , Split Prec. 0.45 0.45 ).
This is a reminder that a high all-class Cl. Acc. on PS-SPLIT must be read alongside Split Precision and Δ ​ ∑ K \Delta\!\sum\!K : a method that always declares “no split” already scores Cl. Acc. 0.80 0.80 on the full dataset (Never-Split in Table A3 ) at no cost, and any improvement beyond that can come either from genuine discrimination or from confident no-split calls on easy controls.
Visual information does still provide a signal for category splitting, and improved backbones and approaches to this task may be able to extract more signal from vision alone, allowing PS-SPLIT to be a useful benchmark for future discovery by category splitting approaches.

第二,Brent + KMEANs 的几个仅可视化的骨干崩溃,接近“永不分裂”的制度。

这提醒大家,PS-SPLIT上的一高一等Cl.Acc必须和Split精度和QQ K\Delta\!\ sum\!K一起阅读: 一种总是宣布“不拆分”的方法已经免费在完整数据集(表A3中的Never-Split)上给Cl.Acc.0.80.0.80评分,任何超出这一评分的改进要么来自真正的歧视,要么来自自信的"不拆分",要求实行简单的控制。

blocks.en:
Method ablation on the full dataset. The four-block per-method ablation ( Table A3 ) extends Table 3 to the full dataset, and also includes the upper and lower bounds described below.
Three patterns are stable across both dataset sizes: (i) Tuning-XMeans degenerates to “never split” on every backbone setup; (ii) Tuning-Agglo over-splits dramatically whenever geographic features are added (e.g., Δ ​ ∑ K = + 534 \Delta\!\sum\!K=+534 on DINOv2 and + 501 +501 on SelEx on the full dataset, the largest absolute deviations in either methods table); (iii) the transformer K-estimator obtains the highest split-only metrics (Cl. Acc. s , K Acc. s ) across most rows, at the cost of over-predicting splits when only visual features are available.
Two findings are clearer on the full dataset than on the small subset.
First, on SelEx with geographic features the transformer is the only row in either methods table where Δ ​ ∑ K \Delta\!\sum\!K becomes negative ( − 12 -12 ); this is a large swing from its same-backbone visual-only value of + 118 +118 and shows that geography can reverse its over-splitting tendency.
Second, Brent-Agglo on SelEx with geographic features achieves the highest non-oracle Cl. Acc. ( 0.82 0.82 ) anywhere in either methods table and one of the highest Split Precision values ( 0.69 0.69 ); under our protocol it is the strongest single-method result we observe on the full dataset.
The remaining gap to the SelEx + geo oracle ( 0.93 0.93 ) is roughly eleven points, slightly smaller than on the small subset.

blocks.en:
Supervised upper bound. To investigate the potential of vision-only features, the supervised probe rows report a separate logistic-regression classifier for each novel coarse class, trained with the fine labels on a stratified 70% of the training-pool images of each novel coarse class and evaluated on its test-pool images (mean over 5 seeds). These probes use privileged supervised information that is not available in the discovery by category splitting setting, and non-splitting species achieve perfect accuracy as there is only a single fine class to predict.
As the supervised probe is given the true K ∗ K^{*} , like the Oracle, its K-estimation metrics are perfect by construction.
Even without geographic information or backbone fine-tuning there is enough visual signal to distinguish between the species in most splits (Cl. Acc. s 0.83 0.83 with DINOv2 on PS-SPLIT-Small and 0.80 0.80 on the full dataset), and adding location features makes the supervised problem almost trivial on PS-SPLIT-Small (Cl. Acc. s 0.98 0.98 ; 0.92 0.92 – 0.93 0.93 on the full dataset). In contrast, in the discovery setting, where the number of fine classes is not known and no fine labels are provided, the best methods remain far from these values, suggesting significant room for improvement as new methods are developed.

由于被监督的探测器被赋予了真实的K *K 与甲骨文一样,它的K-估计度量通过构造是完美的.

Adapted fine-grained datasets. We adapt CUB-200-2011 [ 54 ] , Stanford Cars [ 26 ] , and FGVC Aircraft [ 32 ] to the discovery-by-splitting setting by treating each dataset’s natural higher-level grouping (genus / make / family) as the coarse class and the leaf class as the fine class.

Importantly, and unlike PS-SPLIT, these adapted datasets are not restricted to binary splits: a coarse class can contain up to 30 (CUB-200-2011), 22 (Stanford Cars), or 8 (FGVC Aircraft) fine classes, and the numbers of splitting ( K > 1 K>1 ) and non-splitting ( K = 1 K=1 ) coarse classes are not balanced.

All of the K-estimation and clustering methods we evaluate on PS-SPLIT apply directly to this multi-way setting, and the transformer K-estimator simply sets K max K_{\max} to the largest number of fine classes in any training coarse class.
We restricted PS-SPLIT itself to binary splits as these are the most common form of species-level taxonomic split, with 1,208 binary splits compared to 425 multi-way splits (the majority being three-way) reported on iNaturalist since 2012.

Table A5 reports all-coarse metrics; Table A6 restricts to multi-class classes (true K > 1 K\!>\!1 ) so that the splitting performance can be read in isolation from the no-split background rate.
The most striking difference from PS-SPLIT is that GCD-style fine-tuning of the visual backbone (GCD, SimGCD, SelEx) helps much more on these benchmarks than on PS-SPLIT.
On CUB-200-2011, GCD with Brent + KMeans reaches Cl. Acc. 0.71 0.71 versus 0.61 0.61 for frozen DINOv2 — a ten-point improvement that is essentially absent on PS-SPLIT, where the visual backbones cluster within a few points of each other regardless of fine-tuning.
We attribute this to the smaller and more homogeneous label spaces of the existing benchmarks (200 classes in CUB, 196 in Stanford Cars), where contrastive fine-tuning has more room to specialize to the test distribution.
FGVC Aircraft is anomalous in the opposite direction: most coarse families contain only one fine variant, so methods that lean toward predicting K = 1 K=1 score very high on the all-coarse view (the DINOv1 transformer reaches Cl. Acc. 0.87 0.87 in Table A5 ) while the split-only view ( Table A6 ) shows that on the few real splits these methods barely beat chance (AMI s near zero across most backbones).

blocks.en: Appendix B Generalized Category Discovery Experiments
blocks.zh: 附录B 类别 发现实验

blocks.en:
In addition to the discovery-by-splitting setting evaluated in the main text, PS-SPLIT can be used as a generalized category discovery (GCD) benchmark, in which a model is given labeled examples of a subset of categories ( known ) and unlabeled examples of all categories, and must cluster the unlabeled set so that “new” categories are recovered alongside the known ones [ 52 ] .
The dataset release includes three different sets of known/novel splits: • single splits each pair so that one of the two generated species is in the known set and the other is in the novel set; • paired keeps the two splitting species together (both known or both novel) while placing the taxonomically close control species on the other side; • discovery-by-splitting is the same setting used in the main paper, where each set of aligned coarse categories (the splitting pair plus the control species) are placed together, either all known, or all novel.
blocks.zh:
除了正文中评价的分解发现设置外,PS-SPLIT还可以被作为通用类发现(GCD)的基准,其中给一个模型以分类子集(已知)的被标注的例子和所有分类的无标注的例子,并且必须将未标注的集合组合起来,使"新"分类与已知的分类一起被回收 [52].
数据集发布包括了三组不同的已知/小说分型: •每对单片分型,这样两个生成的物种中的一个在已知的集中,另一个在小说集中; •对子将两个分型的物种放在一起(既已知又同小说),同时将分类学上相近的控制物种放入另一侧; •对子分型是主纸中使用的相同设置,每组对子相近的粗细分类(分对相加控制物种)放在一起,要么全部为已知,要么全部为小说.

blocks.en:
We re-implement four baselines on PS-SPLIT ( Table A7 , single setting) and standard GCD benchmarks [ 54 , 32 , 26 , 27 ] . UNO [ 18 ] , GCD [ 52 ] , SimGCD [ 55 ] , and SelEx [ 40 ] are trained on the dataset using the same DINOv2 ViT-B with registers [ 36 , 15 ] so that backbone choice does not confound the comparison.
Numbers differ slightly from the published values for two reasons: (i) all methods use the same DINOv2 backbone; and (ii) we apply training-script updates that have been merged into the official repositories after publication, which generally improve performance. DINO [ 8 ] and DINOv2 [ 36 ] without further training are also compared using the balanced semi-supervised k k -means clustering algorithm of SelEx [ 40 ] to cluster the image features.
Clustering accuracy for this task is computed with a single Hungarian assignment over all unlabeled instances, as described in Appendix C .

我们重新实施关于PS-SPLIT(表A7,单一设定)和标准GCD基准[54,32,26,27]的4个基线. UNO [18],GCD [52],SimGCD [55],和SelEx [40] 使用相同的DINov2 VIT-B与登记册[36,15]进行数据集培训,以便骨干选择不会混淆比较.
数字与已公布的数值略有不同,原因有两个:(一)所有方法都使用相同的DINOv2主干;和(二)我们应用在发布后被合并入官方寄存库的训练标记更新,这一般能提高性能. 未经进一步培训的DINO [8]和DINOv2 [36] 也使用SELEx [40] 的平衡半监督克-意为集群算法来对图像特性进行分组比较.
如附录C所描述的,对所有未加标签的情况,用匈牙利的单项任务计算出这项任务的准确性。

blocks.en:
Similar trends on the CUB, Cars, Aircraft, and the CIFAR datasets are seen on PS-SPLIT, with SelEx as the strongest baseline, followed by SimGCD and GCD.
The best performance on PS-SPLIT is lower than for any other dataset, showing PS-SPLIT offers value as a benchmark with room for improvement as more powerful category discovery methods are developed.
For SelEx, performance is particularly low for the novel classes, showing that the approach may be struggling to identify the very similar novel classes which have their splitting pair included in the known classes.
As in the real-world “category discovery” task of taxonomic splitting, multiple modalities of data may be required to accurately distinguish between visually similar species, such as vocalizations, geography or genetics.
The inclusion of geographic metadata in PS-SPLIT allows for an approximation of this approach which could lead to improved performance on this category discovery task.
blocks.zh:
在PS-SPLIT上可以看到CUB,汽车,飞机和CIFAR数据集的类似趋势,以SELEx为最强基线,之后是SimGCD和GCD.
PS-SPLIT上的最佳性能低于任何其他数据集,显示PS-SPLIT在开发更强大的类别发现方法时作为基准提供了价值并有改进的余地.
对于SELS来说,小说班的表现特别低,这表明这个方法可能正在努力确定非常相近的小说班级,这些班级在已知班级中包括了他们的分对.
与现实世界的“分类发现”分门别类任务一样,可能需要多种数据模式来准确区分视觉相似的物种,如声学、地理学或遗传学。
将地理元数据列入PS-SPLIT可以使这种方法近似化,从而可以改善这一类别发现任务的业绩。

blocks.en:
PS-SPLIT is built from research-grade observations on iNaturalist [ 24 ] whose licenses permit redistribution for research, restricted to the class Aves (birds).
iNaturalist provides a large source of image data of species, however, the only criteria to be accepted as research-grade is that community members agree that the image contains evidence of the species being present, which does not necessarily align with images that are useful for computer vision tasks.
Due to this we construct a multi-stage pipeline to maximize the quality of the images that are included in PS-SPLIT.
The pipeline runs in five stages: split selection, control selection, image cap with user diversification, MegaDetector [ 3 ] crop filtering, and a vision-language quality filter. Splits whose two new species are too visually similar to be discriminated above chance are removed by a final DINOv2 [ 36 ] screen. The resulting dataset contains 79,061 images across 771 species drawn from 257 splits.
blocks.zh:
PS-SPLIT是根据iNaturalist[24]上的研究级观测结果建立的,其许可证允许对研究进行再分配,仅限于Aves类(鸟类)。
iNaturalist提供了物种图像数据的一大来源,然而,作为研究级唯一可以被接受的标准是社区成员同意图像中包含物种存在的证据,这不一定与对计算机视觉任务有用的图像一致.
因此,我们建造了一个多阶段管道,以最大限度地提高PS-SPLIT中所含图像的质量。
管道分五个阶段运行:分割选择,控制选择,具有用户多样化的图像封顶,巨型探测器[3]作物过滤,以及视觉语言质量过滤. 其两个新物种在视觉上过于相近,无法在机会上受到歧视的分块被最终的DINOv2[36]屏幕取出. 由此产生的数据集中包含由257个分块抽取的771个物种的79,061个图像.

blocks.en:
Candidate splits are taken from the iNaturalist taxonomic changes page [ 25 ] , restricted to two-way splits in which both generated species have at least 20 research-grade observations and have not undergone any further taxonomic changes. For every split, a third taxonomically close “control” species is selected from the same genus (or family, when the genus has no qualifying member), preferring species with similar observation counts and overlapping geographic range that have not undergone any taxonomic changes on iNaturalist. The choice of control species is intended to prevent discovery by category splitting methods from learning to predict that a category splits based on coarse-category size, broad taxonomic groupings, or geographic region.
We do not require controls to be visually indistinguishable from their splitting species, as the control is a different coarse class and the splitting decision is made within a single coarse class. However, as controls are taxonomically close they are typically somewhat visually similar, which prevents shortcuts such as “all ducks should be split”. For example, Fig. A15 and Fig. A14 show the visually similar control species alongside the corresponding splitting species.

我们并不要求控制与其分化的物种在视觉上是无法区分的,因为控制是不同的粗细类,分化的决定是在单一粗细类内作出的。 然而,由于控制在分类上是接近的,它们通常在视觉上是相似的,这妨碍了诸如“所有鸭子都应被拆分”之类的捷径。 例如:"Fig. A15"和"Fig". A14显示视相类似的控制物种与相应的分裂物种。

blocks.en:
Crops that pass MegaDetector are reviewed by a Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct VLM [ 2 ] reviewer. The system prompt and per-image prompt template are reproduced in Fig. A3 .
The reviewer answers seven binary questions about the image: is a bird present? (not a nest, egg, or footprint); is the bird an adult?; is most of the body in frame?; is the subject in focus?; is there text or a watermark present in the image?; is the image unusual (such as a photograph of a screen, photograph through a telescope eyepiece, or an image with heavy processing or illustration included)?; and are there any other prominent animals in frame?
The reviewer also assigns a broad pose label from { perched , flying , on-ground , in-water , other }.
An image is only kept if responses to all questions match our criteria.
After per-image filtering, a pose-consistency pass selects the most common pose across the two species in a split and keeps only images of that pose, ensuring that the split decision cannot be made by detecting pose alone; the filter falls back to the full pose set for any species that would otherwise drop below 20 images.
The control species is filtered in the same way, separately from its splitting pair. We do not enforce that the control pose matches the splitting pose, but in practice the pose distributions are very similar, with 82.3% of splitting species and 85% of control species being perched , reflecting the types of images users upload to iNaturalist. Most coarse classes strongly favour a single pose even without filtering.
If images have been rejected by the Megadetector or the VLM reviewer, additional images are downloaded and the process repeats until we have reached the maximum image cap or have exhausted all suitable images for that species. Fig. A4 shows images for the Northern Nutcracker that have been accepted or rejected by the reviewer.

评论员回答7个关于图像的二进制问题:有鸟存在吗?. (不是巢穴、蛋或足迹);鸟是成人吗? ;大部分身体在框中吗? ; 焦点是目标吗? 图像中是否有文字或水印? 图像是否不寻常(例如屏幕的照片、通过望远镜的目镜所拍摄的照片、或带有重加工或插图的图像)? 框架中是否有任何其他显著动物?

blocks.en:
After per-image filtering, every split is evaluated by a DINOv2 [ 36 ] ViT-B linear probe trained on 20% of the species’ images and evaluated on the held-out 80%. Splits whose two new species could not be reliably distinguished (probe accuracy below 60%) are excluded from the curated subset on the basis that the visual signal alone is insufficient for category discovery.
This is required as some taxonomic splits are based solely on non visual characteristics such as genetic analaysis, and the species produced by the taxonomic split are visually indistinguishable.
However in total only six of the 263 candidate splits were removed (2.3%); two examples (Philippine vs. Sulawesi Honey-buzzard, Common vs. Sri Lankan Green Bee-eater) are shown in Figures A5 and A6 .
While experts can potentially tell these species apart, it seems to be difficult, particularly for the Philippine Honey-buzzard and Sulawesi Honey-buzzard, where plumage can vary significantly within each species.
As this screen uses a pretrained representation to decide which splits are retained, it could introduce selection bias. We analyze the sensitivity of the benchmark statistics and of the method rankings to the threshold in Sec. F.1 .

在逐一进行图像过滤后,每分出一个DINov2[36] VIT-B线性探测器,经过20%的物种图像培训,并在被搁置的80%上进行评估。 无法可靠地区分出两个新物种(概率低于60%)的分片被排除出被分集,理由是光是视觉信号不足以进行类别发现。
之所以需要这样,是因为一些分类分裂完全基于基因麻醉等非视觉特征,而分类分裂所产生的物种在视觉上是无法区分的.
然而,在263名候选人中,总共只有6人被删除(2.3%);图A5和A6列出了两个例子(菲利平诉苏拉威西·哈尼-布扎德案、普通诉斯里兰卡绿蜂案)。

由于这个屏幕使用预先训练过的表示器来决定哪些分块被保留,它可能会引入选择偏差. 我们分析基准统计的敏感性以及方法对Sec.F.1中阈值的排名。

The pipeline produces 79,061 images across 771 species (257 splitting pairs + 257 taxonomically similar control species), spanning 22 orders, 94 families, and 262 genera. The “small” version retains 64 splitting pairs where the average number of images per class is balanced, and their 64 associated control species, totaling 25,285 images across 192 species (14 orders, 46 families, 77 genera), approximately matching the total size of existing fine-grained visual classification datasets [ 54 , 32 , 26 ] and keeping a more balanced number of images per class.
The full per-species taxonomy is shipped as supplementary JSON files ( taxonomy_full.json and taxonomy_small.json ; see Appendix H ); aggregate dataset statistics are reported in Table 1 .

blocks.en:
Architecture. The K-estimator consists of two components: a permutation-invariant transformer s ψ s_{\psi} that processes a set of per-instance feature tokens for a single coarse class, and a cardinality predictor k ω k_{\omega} that maps the resulting CLS-token representation to a distribution over { 1 , … , K max } \{1,\ldots,K_{\max}\} . s ψ s_{\psi} is a 2-layer 8-head transformer with token dimension 128 and feedforward dimension 256, followed by a final MLP with one 128-dimensional hidden layer that projects to a 64-dimensional output.

blocks.en: Appendix G Geographic Distribution
blocks.zh: 附录G 分发

blocks.en: PS-SPLIT inherits its spatial coverage from iNaturalist [ 24 ] : every accepted observation in the dataset corresponds to a research-grade record uploaded by a citizen-science contributor and georeferenced at the point of observation. As a consequence, the geographic distribution of PS-SPLIT may more closely mirror that of iNaturalist participation rather than the true global distribution of avian biodiversity. Earlier benchmarks built from the same source [ 49 , 31 ] have noted similar effects: contributor density is highest in North America, Western Europe, and parts of South and Southeast Asia, and is sparser across much of Africa, the Middle East, and central Asia. Methods that exploit the location metadata in PS-SPLIT (e.g., as in [ 14 , 11 ] ) should account for this sampling bias rather than treat observation density as an unbiased indicator of habitat preference. To partially mitigate the effect at the species level, the construction pipeline (Appendix D ) caps the number of images per species which reduces the global imbalance somewhat, and prefers different uploaders, which works to flatten the localized geographic imbalance from single users uploading many observations from an area local to them.
blocks.zh: PS-SPLIT从iNaturalist [24]继承了它的空间覆盖:数据集中每一个被接受的观测都对应一个公民-科学贡献者上传的研究级记录,并在观测点被地理参考. 因此,PS-SPLIT的地理分布可能更接近于iNaturalist的参与,而不是禽类生物多样性的真正全球分布。 来自同一来源的早期基准[49,31]也注意到类似的影响:北美、西欧、南亚和东南亚部分地区的缴款密度最高,非洲、中东和中亚大部分地区则比较稀少。 利用PS-SPLIT中的位置元数据(如[14,11])的方法应当考虑到这种取样偏差,而不是将观测密度视为生境偏好的一个无偏见的指标。 为了部分地减轻物种层面的影响,建筑管道(附录D)将每个物种的图像数量封顶,从而在一定程度上减轻了全球不平衡,并倾向于不同的上传者,这有助于平息单个用户从一个地区向它们上传许多观测结果的局部地域不平衡。

PS-SPLIT spans 22 orders, 94 families, and 262 genera; the small subset spans 14 orders, 46 families, and 77 genera. Figure A12 visualises the order/family/genus distribution for the full dataset as concentric rings, with the larger segments labelled, and Fig. A13 shows the corresponding figure for the small subset.
The full per-species taxonomy — iNaturalist taxon IDs, binomial nomenclature, splitting/control type, and per-species image counts — is shipped as supplementary JSON files ( taxonomy_full.json and taxonomy_small.json ) rather than as in-paper tables, since 771 species do not fit naturally inside a PDF.
The JSON is hierarchical: each Aves → \to Order → \to Family → \to Genus → \to Species branch carries a summary block with n_orders , n_families , n_genera , n_species , and n_images aggregated at that level, and each species leaf carries its iNaturalist taxon_id , its type ( Split or Control ), and its image count.

blocks.en:
Coverage and balance. The taxonomy is dominated by Passeriformes (perching birds), the largest avian order in nature with roughly half of all extant species [ 13 ] ; PS-SPLIT reflects this — Passeriformes accounts for the largest share of species in both Fig. A12 and Fig. A13 .
Other orders represented by multiple split–control pairs include Charadriiformes (shorebirds and gulls), Apodiformes (hummingbirds), Strigiformes (owls), and Procellariiformes (tubenoses); a long tail of additional orders contributes one or a few pairs each.
This concentration reflects underlying biology rather than any sampling choice: groups that are both species-rich and currently subject to active taxonomic revision contribute more documented splits.
The pairing of every splitting coarse class with a taxonomically close control (Appendix D ) keeps the order/family distribution roughly symmetric between splitting and non-splitting halves.
